metadata.description: Delegate work from Claude Code to other AI coding agents: Codex (community fork with Windows fixes) and Cursor, plus a goal plugin for long-horizon project goals.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: cursor
plugins.description: Use Cursor from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.

plugins.name: goal
plugins.description: Set a long-horizon goal in a project and advance it one increment at a time, delegating to Codex/Cursor.
